summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancements to the Iceberg-Spark integration, including improvements for small file workloads and variant type support. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about REST specifications, including the introduction of a generic CatalogObjectIdentifier and the need for better OAuth2 support in REST clients.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Java REST client URL encoding issues
Proposal for Fine Grained Access Control in REST catalogs
